name: Fireworks AI
description: AI inference platform for deploying and running LLMs. Monitor API access.

config.setupInstructions:
1. Go to the Fireworks AI dashboard at https://app.fireworks.ai
2. Navigate to Settings > API Keys
3. Create a new API key (an account-admin scoped key is required for the Employee Access check)
4. Copy the key and enter it above

checks.name: Fireworks AI App Availability
checks.description: Checks that the Fireworks AI API is accessible.

checks.name: Fireworks AI Employee Access
checks.description: Verifies employee access to Fireworks AI via API.
